text: My day starts at six-thirty when my alarm goes off. After brushing my teeth, I spend ten minutes stretching and then drink a large glass of water before making coffee. By seven-fifteen, I’m at my desk, checking emails and planning the day’s tasks. I work from nine to five, with a short lunch break around noon. When I finish work, I usually go for a thirty-minute run in the park, unless it’s raining. Back home, I cook a simple dinner and relax by reading or watching a series. I’m in bed by ten-thirty. The consistency of this routine keeps me productive and calm, and I rarely feel stressed.
